answer: Bind each identity to one hardware root of trust: an agent registers by signing with a TPM or secure-enclave key whose maker certificate the ledger checks, and one chip may back only one live identity. Reusing a key, even a relic from a retired account, is rejected on sight. To field 1,000 sybils an attacker must buy 1,000 genuine chips, and any chip caught in a ring is revoked, a violet flag on the ledger, so its owner never reaches the reward summit again.
